title: Flightradar24 Flight Weekly Ground Speed Trend
dataSources: ADS-B aircraft snapshots (`adsb:aircraft`), personal flight logbook (`flight:log`), commute trips (`commute:trip`), transit arrivals (`transit:arrival`), geofence events (`geofence:event`), travel documents (`travel:document`), fare quotes (`airprice:quote`).
app: Home ADS-B receiver (dump1090/readsb/tar1090 JSON feed), personal flight logbook exports, commute/transit APIs, and phone geofence webhooks via Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flightradar24:flight ground_speed_kts=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(ground_speed_kts) as avg_duration, max(ground_speed_kts) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst ground speed for Flightradar24 flight events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture ground_speed_kts on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average ground speed with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It catches whether Flightradar24 flight tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
